epilogues.title: The Empress Falls Silent
epilogues.body: The Acid Ant Empress shatters and the crystal orders lose their grip. The freed ants remember their own names — and point Momo toward the drains where the sour acid still flows.
epilogues.why: Follow the poisoned current downstream to find its source.

epilogues.title: The Pipes Run Clear
epilogues.body: Clogmaw bursts and the fermented flood drains away. In the last trickle Momo hears a furnace roar far below — something is boiling the stolen acid into raw power.
epilogues.why: Descend to the Chili Engine before it finishes stoking.

epilogues.title: The Furnace Goes Cold
epilogues.body: Mr. Griddle sputters out and his cursed engine stalls. But that heat was feeding a freezer above, where sweet flavor-spirits are being frozen as the next batch of fuel.
epilogues.why: Climb to the Sugar Frost Prison and free the captured flavors.

epilogues.title: The Ice Lets Go
epilogues.body: The Golem melts into slush and the frozen spirits drift free, whispering their thanks. They warn of a crown-shaped oven higher up, where the Bitter Chef prepares his final course.
epilogues.why: Ascend to the Crown Oven and end the Bitter Chef for good.

epilogues.title: The Great Hunger Recedes
epilogues.body: The Great Hunger collapses and taste floods back into Mochitopia in a rush of color and sound. Yet from the cooling oven a single crown seed rolls free — and roots upward, toward the garden above.
epilogues.why: Chapter 1 is complete. Chase the seed into the Fermented Canopy.

epilogues.title: The First Bloom Withers
epilogues.body: Rootmother’s Bud unwinds into drifting spores, revealing that it was only an avatar grown from the crown seed. Beneath the canopy, a fungal pulse answers from the Mycelium Marsh.
epilogues.why: Follow the moving pocket of clean air into the marsh and find the body feeding the colony.

epilogues.title: The Marsh Remembers
epilogues.body: The Mycelium Behemoth releases every memory trapped in its colony. Their scent leads upward to a royal hive feeding on the garden’s last nectar.
epilogues.why: Carry the clean memories into the Nectar Hive before the royal ferment consumes them.

epilogues.title: The Crown Loses Its Swarm
epilogues.body: The Ferment Hornet Queen falls and the protected nectar flowers ring like bells. Their rhythm opens a glass path where four seasons are running at once.
epilogues.why: Enter the Four-Season Conservatory and repair the broken calendar.

epilogues.title: The Last Hour Opens
epilogues.body: Chronobloom Orchid returns each season to its rightful path. Beneath its clock, an ancient stair descends toward the first root and the throne that planted every curse.
epilogues.why: Descend to the Root Throne and face the True Rootmother.

epilogues.title: Memories Choose Their Own Shape
epilogues.body: The True Rootmother’s crown breaks. Every stolen memory escapes the roots and returns to Mochitopia—not as an order, but as a choice. Momo sees the crown seed bloom once more, now harmless and free.
epilogues.why: Chapter 2 is complete. But the freed memories keep pointing somewhere older — to the fields where the first crown was planted.

epilogues.title: The Harvest Lies Down
epilogues.body: The Harvest Colossus crumbles back into ash and straw. Beneath it, rows of hollow trees stretch toward the horizon, their flavor carved out and carried away.
epilogues.why: Walk into the Hollow Orchard and find where the stolen taste went.

epilogues.title: The Orchard Breathes Again
epilogues.body: The Hollow Bloom scatters its stolen flavors back into the trees, and the first fruit in centuries begins to swell. The last sap still flows uphill — toward a broken greenhouse of glass.
epilogues.why: Follow the sap into the Glass Greenhouse Ruins.

epilogues.title: Every Future Shatters But One
epilogues.body: The Glass Gardener’s panes break and the false futures fade. Only one reflection stays true: a sealed vault holding every crown seed ever grown.
epilogues.why: Open the Seed Vault before another crown can be planted.

epilogues.title: The Vault Is Empty of Fear
epilogues.body: The Seedwarden falls and the jars of crown seeds dim into ordinary seeds, harmless and small. Under the vault floor, a single ancient root pulses toward a quiet throne.
epilogues.why: Climb the root to the Throne of the First Seed and meet the Planter.

epilogues.title: The Cycle Ends With a Choice
epilogues.body: The First Planter kneels as the last crown seed cracks in Momo’s hands. It was never a seed of hunger — only a seed of wanting, planted too deep. Momo plants it again, in the sun, and it grows into an ordinary sweet tree. Mochitopia is whole.
epilogues.why: The story is complete. The endgame kitchens are open — Recipe Maps, the Atlas and the Pinnacle await.
